conclusion.measured: All prior Nebius stock runs used an upstream revision missing four files referenced by its unchanged index.
conclusion.claim_effect: Prior quality, throughput, trace, and cost results are not valid evidence for the complete intended checkpoint.
conclusion.inference: Missing complete layer weights plausibly contributed to the high NLL and formatting failures, but sufficiency requires a complete-checkpoint rerun.
conclusion.trace_limit: The v9 trace remains useful only for diagnostic kernel-shape attribution because the configured architecture still executed those shapes.
